NPM_MIN_RELEASE_AGE.title: npm release age for this plugin's server
NPM_MIN_RELEASE_AGE.description: How long npm holds back a new release of the plugin's server before starting it, as npm's min-release-age measures it. It replaces your own min-release-age for this one package, which is a single file with no dependencies. Set 0 to start a new release at once. Leave it unset to keep the min-release-age your .npmrc sets, which can stop the server starting for a while after each release.
